the poets, Colleen J. McElroy [and others] ; the printers, Mary Ann Hayden [and others].

"The poets : Colleen J. McElroy / Carolyn Kizer / Frances Mayes / Josephine Miles / Janet Lewis [/] Denise Levertov / Alma Villanueva / Bernice Zamora / Louise Gluck [/] Chana Bloch / Audre Lorde / Kitty Tsui / Kathleen Fraser / Judy Grahn / Sandra M. Gilbert."

"The printers : Mary Ann Hayden / Felicia Rice /Christine Bertelson / Jaime Robles [/] Eileen Callahan / Robin Heyeck / Betsy Davids / Bonnie Bernstein [/] Susan King / Shelly Hoyt-Koch / Carol Denison / Frances Butler / Cheryl Miller [/] Leigh McLellan / Georgianna Greenwood / Kathy Walkup."

"The fifteen broadsides in this portfolio were prepared in conjunction with a conference on Women Writing Poetry in America, sponsored by the Center for Research on Women, Stanford University, and held in April, 1982. There are seventy sets signed by the poets; twenty are hors de commerce. Editors: Diane Middlebrook, Kathy Walkup ..."--Verso of title sheet.
Issued in paper portfolio by Frances Butler (Poltroon Press, Berkeley).
The presses include: Matrix Press, Meadow Press, Calliopea Press, and Interval Press; Paradise Press, Moving Parts Press, Black Stone Press, The Heyeck Press, and The Goodmorrow Press.

Interior, with Madame Vuillard and son / Kathleen Fraser ; with a drawing by JoAnn Ugolini. [Calif.] : Sombre Reptiles -- For Jan, as the end draws near / Carolyn Kizer. [Palo Alto] : Matrix Press -- Ions / Josephine Miles ; design and calligraphy by Georgianna Greenwood -- Why women need to dance / Colleen J. McElroy. [Calif.] : Callahan & Okamura -- Betatakin first seen: autumn / Janet Lewis. [San Francisco] : Meadow Press -- Seeing for a moment / Denise Levertov ; design & printing by Jaime Robles -- 22 ointments against the hand of a ghost / Frances Mayes. [Oakland, Calif. : Rebis Press] -- Unknown / Alma Villanueva. [Riverside, Calif. : Rara Avis Press] -- Dominion / Bernice Zamora. [Santa Monica, Calif.] : Paradise Press -- Brooding likeness / Louise Glu·ck ; art: Wendy Hebborn. [Calif.] : Goodmorrow Press -- Perfection / Chana Bloch. [Woodside, Calif.] : Heyeck Press -- Nightvision / Kitty Tsui. [Calif.] : Moving Parts Press -- The good weef is both / Judy Grahn. [Calif.] : Interval Press -- The voice of evil / Sandra M. Gilbert. [San Francisco] : Black Stone Press -- Love poem / Audre Lorde ; illustration by Patricia Waters. [Calif.] : Calliopea Press.
Manuscript, Archives, and Rare Book Library copy is no. 59 of 70 sets signed by the poets; forms part of the Raymond Danowski Poetry Library.
